about_the_game:
Colonize Galaxies

This DLC offers whole galaxies with up to 20 planets to explore and populate. They can be played both in a free endless mode or in a competitive game mode against AI corporations.

The Space Station

It serves as our headquarters and central hub for planetary colonies. It also enables interplanetary research and allows us to unlock extensions for city centers.

Orbital Space Lift

With this new high-tech construct we can move our resources and items quickly and free of charge between the planetary colonies and the space station.

Extensions

Extensions provide special abilities for our city centers. A maximum of 3 of them can be installed per city center.

Introductory Story Campaign

The DLC features a Story Campaign centered around the Genesis Seed Initiative, starring our new USN Advisor Ixas. It spans accross four planets.

Galaxy-Wide Competition

Each planet will generate continuous income to be used for subsequent colonies. The party that has earned the most victory points at the end of the pioneer phase is announced main administrator of the galaxy.

Space Capsule Delivery

City Center capsules can now pack items from the space station. We can redefine the extensions to be installed before landing.

  • OS: Ubuntu & SteamOS latest LTS
  • Processor: 2 GHz or multiple cores with 1,5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan compliant graphics card with 1GB dedicated memory
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Colonize entire galaxies in a campaign-style. Compete for victory points to become galaxy ruler. Manage your central space station for research, trading, and tech licensing. Use Orbital Lifts for free resource transfers. Customize city centers with extensions and explore a 4-planet Story Campaign.
